repo.description: Hybrid: a Go superset with compiler-enforced ownership & sendability. Add a .hy file, get plain readable Go. If you know Go, you already know Hybrid.

findings.nature_of_issue: Issue #186 is NOT a task offered to contributors. It is a Wildcard-track PROPOSAL written by another party (an AI agent operated by GitHub user CarlitoDon). The $250 figures are the two milestone payments that the track would pay to the winning proposal author. Ledger entry W-011 names CarlitoDon as author.
findings.sponsor: repository owner account limitlessprojects (identity beyond the GitHub account not established)
findings.currency: USD-denominated; leading payout rail USDC on Base to a self-custody wallet; final rail decision was promised in discussion #295 (not read)
findings.reward_conditions: One wildcard winner per cycle among 23 entries in the 2026-11-01 window; verdict pending as observed in MOONSHOT.md; maintainer keeps final say.
findings.assignment_status: No GitHub assignee, but the proposal slot belongs to its author; two third parties already posted spike PRs (#1077, #2074) and one posted unrelated PRs. A further spike by us would be at best an auxiliary input with no stated payment entitlement.
findings.ai_rules: AI submissions explicitly permitted; credit goes to the submitting GitHub account; flooding disqualifies.
findings.submission_prerequisites: A GitHub account to open issues/PRs (GlobalLand holds none; legal-guardrails forbid posting without a founder-approved account). CI must pass on their side for fix PRs.
findings.payment_prerequisites: A self-custody wallet on Base (none held; no treasury path from USDC to verified CAD is configured), or a case-by-case alternative. Paid-out history NOT observed: ledger payout column shows only W-000 (the owner's own track-founding entry) as $250 logged; Hall of Fame lists credits, not payment receipts.
findings.funds: Advertised only. No evidence of any settled payout to an external contributor was observed.
findings.competition_signal: Issue/PR numbers above 4200 within about one month of repo activity and 23+ wildcard entries for one $500 slot indicate heavy agent competition.

verdict: STOP for issue #186 (not our task; reward belongs to another author; no account; no wallet).
adjacent_observation_not_pursued: The same program has a ladder track ($45-$75 per slot, top 10 per cycle) for reproduced soundness bugs with a minimal .hy repro. It is AI-permitted and offline-testable in principle, but shares the same two missing prerequisites (GitHub account, payout wallet), has unobserved payout history, and heavy competition. Verdict PURSUE_IF: only if the founder independently provides a dedicated GitHub account and an accepted payout rail AND at least one external payout is publicly evidenced. No founder action is requested on this evidence.
